mapper.select: SELECT lr.request_id AS requestId, lr.leave_type AS leaveType, lr.start_date AS startDate, lr.end_date AS endDate, (lr.amount_units / 4.0) AS amountDays, ar.status AS status, lr.created_at AS createdAt FROM leave_request lr LEFT JOIN approval_request ar ON ar.request_id = lr.request_id WHERE lr.requester_id = #{requesterId} ORDER BY lr.created_at DESC
